priority_definition.P0: Can cause a wrong scientific decision, wrong retrieval, unsupported citation or false certainty.
priority_definition.P1: A core midterm task lacks sufficient decision depth.
priority_definition.P2: Useful expansion but not required for the Midterm Core.

gaps.finding: evidence_index_manifest declares 773 dense vectors while the JSONL is empty and the runtime .npy/metadata files are absent.
gaps.failure_mode: evaluation or UI may report dense readiness that runtime cannot provide
gaps.current_containment: HybridRetrievalService can fall back to FTS5 when it observes missing runtime artifacts
gaps.required_before_midterm: Make reported dense availability match loadable artifacts; do not change ranking semantics as part of this audit.

gaps.finding: 10 trusted_core formal benchmark chunks are source_bound=false and lack exact resolvable spans.
gaps.failure_mode: retrieved benchmark assertions can be cited as decision support without a valid evidence object
gaps.current_containment: decision-local grounding should abstain from unsupported references
gaps.required_before_midterm: Exclude them from supported-citation eligibility or bind them to verified spans.

gaps.finding: The CellTypist/SingleR benchmark source record points to a quarantined, unrelated PanomiR PDF candidate.
gaps.failure_mode: wrong-source evidence
gaps.required_before_midterm: Verify the quarantine remains a hard exclusion in every benchmark/recommendation lane.

gaps.finding: 0/17 canonical software-document sources are pinned to an immutable release/tag/commit.
gaps.failure_mode: current README/stable/devel semantics may be applied to frozen operator versions
gaps.required_before_midterm: Version-sensitive requirements must use pinned source revisions or remain unknown.

gaps.finding: Harmony KG operator revision is 2.0.5; production ToolContract is 2.0.0.
gaps.failure_mode: scientific applicability and execution interface can refer to different implementations
gaps.current_containment: candidate knowledge status and bounded integration tests
gaps.required_before_midterm: Resolve identity or explicitly prove compatible inheritance before treating the path as version-consistent.

gaps.finding: SingleR KG operator revision is 2.14.1; ToolContract is 2.14.0.
gaps.failure_mode: reference and API requirements can be attributed to the wrong release
gaps.required_before_midterm: Keep the path non-ready until versions are reconciled.

gaps.finding: CellTypist model, SingleR reference and pySCENIC database resources lack immutable ReferenceArtifactRevision identities and digests.
gaps.failure_mode: existence of a matrix may be mistaken for scientifically compatible reference input
gaps.current_containment: CellTypist/SingleR execution disabled; pySCENIC not production-used
gaps.required_before_midterm: Reference-dependent scenarios must block or clarify rather than claim applicability.

gaps.finding: The core candidate contains 66 CAN_FEED relations; many predate the corrected proof model and do not establish cross-tool version, identity, alignment, parameter or staleness compatibility.
gaps.failure_mode: coarse type equality can create an invalid workflow edge
gaps.current_containment: core candidate is not promoted; production uses only the corrected UAT overlay
gaps.required_before_midterm: Do not use these relations as trusted planner edges without reviewed derivation proofs.

gaps.finding: All 236 core claims and 171 derived relations remain candidate_pending_review despite structural schema validity.
gaps.failure_mode: scope-complete records may still encode scientifically over-broad requirements
gaps.current_containment: candidate knowledge status is exposed in production justification
gaps.required_before_midterm: Only the independently reviewed benchmark propositions may act as gold; unreviewed candidate KG cannot serve as scientific gold.

gaps.finding: 344/783 evidence chunks are general claims.
gaps.failure_mode: method identity/overview can outrank direct input/output/limitation evidence
gaps.current_containment: atomic claim grounding prefers direct support
gaps.required_before_midterm: Report claim-type denominators and direct-support precision separately.

gaps.finding: RNA velocity has 221 task-tagged chunks while ambient RNA and GRN each have 1; edgeR, Slingshot and pySCENIC have zero direct tool chunks.
gaps.failure_mode: benchmark task coverage is mistaken for comparable evidence depth
gaps.required_before_midterm: Do not aggregate across task families without coverage stratification.

gaps.finding: HVG, PCA, neighbors and UMAP lack dedicated canonical task tags and are inferred through broad Scanpy/clustering categories.
gaps.failure_mode: wrong-task filtering and unstable retrieval denominators
gaps.required_before_midterm: Treat task-specific retrieval coverage as PARTIAL.

gaps.finding: SoupX empty-droplet profile input semantics remain an explicit core EvidenceGap; the later pilot claim remains candidate_pending_review.
gaps.failure_mode: ambient correction may be planned without the required capture-level evidence
gaps.required_before_midterm: Keep SoupX path not ready; benchmark may test acquisition/governance, not trusted execution.

gaps.finding: MOFA2/scvi-tools candidate types describe modalities, but actual sample/component identity alignment remains runtime-owned and unbound.
gaps.failure_mode: scientific overlap may be conflated with actual aligned runtime instances
gaps.required_before_midterm: Keep scientific support and runtime identity validation separate in gold and reporting.

gaps.finding: edgeR pseudobulk ports exist, but sample/donor/replicate/design/contrast semantics are high-risk and have not been independently adjudicated for production.
gaps.failure_mode: cell-level observations may be treated as independent biological replicates
gaps.required_before_midterm: No claim of pseudobulk planning readiness.

gaps.finding: Only Scanpy/Harmony/Scrublet bounded decisions reach CapabilityPlanCompiler through ScientificKGApplicability; the other 11 core ecosystems do not.
gaps.failure_mode: graph presence is misreported as Agent capability
gaps.required_before_midterm: Report 3/14 planning-ready, not 14/14.

gaps.finding: Only 5 of the 14 core ecosystems have a ToolContract; only Harmony and Scrublet are enabled and integration-passed under the strict execution-ready definition.
gaps.failure_mode: scientific candidate depth is confused with execution feasibility
gaps.current_containment: execution and scientific promotion are separate
gaps.required_before_midterm: Report execution readiness separately; do not block candidate scientific knowledge solely for missing runtime binding.

gaps.finding: BenchmarkStudy, EvaluationDataset and EmpiricalResult are 0 in the v1 core conformance bundle.
gaps.failure_mode: no evidence-grounded universal or scoped method ranking can be claimed
gaps.current_containment: dataset-scoped pilot evaluations live in Decision Graph and carry limitations
gaps.required_before_midterm: Method recommendation must avoid unsupported superiority claims.

gaps.finding: MOFA2 feature-weight output is an explicit optional coverage gap.
gaps.failure_mode: incomplete interpretation workflow, not incorrect current applicability
gaps.required_before_midterm: May remain not_run/unknown.

gaps.finding: 1847 catalog records are discovery metadata, not verified scientific capabilities.
gaps.failure_mode: node count used as capability claim
gaps.required_before_midterm: Defer broad catalog enrichment; report it only as recall/discovery coverage.
